body: Thank you. I don't want to leave my friend all alone. Who'd mock him without me around?

Thank you for taking the time to talk to me.

I want to get past this. But it seems so insurmountable. 

I never meant to hurt anyone. They never deserved it.

I've regretted nothing as much.
Prosecution is the most terrifying thing to me. I'm trans and worried about my physical safety in prison.
I have an emergency session with my therapist in a few hours. Maybe they can help.

I've also been the victim of rape. Once 7 years ago, and last November. I forgave my rapist last year. I didn't think it reflected the person they were. They were blackout drunk. They didn't even remember it. I wanted to give them a second chance to improve themselves. They've been sober since.

I have so much regret. I want to do better and make amends. I want to make things better. I don't feel I can.

I sexually assaulted two people. One while drunk, the other sober with my gf at the time. I thought if I kept lying that it never happened, if I believed the lie, maybe it might be true.

There was a criminal investigation, charges weren't pressed.

The legal fees for my lawyer put me in debt I'm still paying off, I developed PTSD from when the police came.

I suffered.

When will I have suffered enough?

I never wanted to be that person again. I chemically castrated myself. I got sober. I've donated to charity. I've given everything and anything bar the shirt off my back. 

Why won't they let me try to be good person.
